blocks.content: Understanding the historical background is essential to comprehending the foundational structure of constitutional governance.

items: Pay special attention to the division of powers under the Government of India Act 1935.
Differentiate clearly between the provisions of the 1919 Act (Dyarchy in provinces) and the 1935 Act (Dyarchy at the Center).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The historical background traces the evolution of administrative and constitutional frameworks in India.
Key legislative acts under British rule systematically shaped the modern constitutional structure.
The Government of India Act 1935 served as a primary structural source for the Indian Constitution.
